title: Side project: what to build next?
question: Which option should the maker take next, given the whole state, to best serve `maker.goal` within `maker.time_available`?

maker.who: Solo developer building a small recipe-sharing web app on evenings and weekends.
maker.goal: Reach 100 weekly active users within three months and learn whether anyone will pay.

product.status: Live for six weeks. 40 signups, 9 weekly actives. Users can post recipes and browse; there is no search, no mobile layout, and no way to save favourites.
feedback: I can't find the recipe I saw last week.
Would love to follow specific cooks.
Why is there no dark mode?

options.search: Add full-text search over recipes and ingredients.
options.mobile: Make the existing pages work well on phones.
options.favourites: Let users save recipes and follow other cooks.
options.paid_tier: Add a paid tier (ad-free, private recipes) to test willingness to pay now.

impact.instructions: If the maker built `option` next, how much would it move the product toward `maker.goal`, given `product.status` and `product.feedback`?
levels: No noticeable change in how people use the app
Small polish: a few users are happier, but retention and growth stay the same
Clear improvement: removes one concrete reason people stop coming back
Major improvement: the app becomes materially more useful every week
Transformational: the main blocker to the goal is gone

effort.instructions: How much of the maker's time (`maker.time_available`) would `option` realistically take before it is live?

risk.instructions: How likely is `option` to break something that works today, or to stall half-finished?
levels: Very low: additive and easy to revert
Low: touches existing pages but in contained ways
Moderate: reworks core flows that could regress
High: changes data model or pricing; mistakes are visible to every user
Very high: likely to be abandoned before it ships

retention_problem.instructions: Is the main problem that existing users do not come back, rather than that too few people sign up?

ready_to_charge.instructions: Is there enough evidence of value that charging money now would be a fair test rather than premature?

growth_ideas.instructions: Which single growth tactic is most likely to bring new weekly active users to this app over the next month?

candidates.share_links: Public share links for each recipe with a nice preview card.
candidates.weekly_digest: A weekly email digest of new recipes to existing users.
candidates.reddit_posts: Posting the best recipes to relevant subreddits with a link back.
candidates.invite_friends: An 'invite a friend' prompt after a user posts their first recipe.

growth_ideas.effort_instructions: How much of the maker's time would `candidate` take to ship?
